text:
Aisha: Quick sync — I’m pulling together the benchmark narrative for launch. Need two lightweight assets by EOD Thu: 1) a sparkplot: cost per 1k tokens vs median latency comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private; 2) a 3-panel explainer slide (median, p95 tail, token-econ $/1k). One slide + one 30s social clip. Who can own the charts?

Evan: I can dig numbers. Do we want end-to-end numbers (including infra overhead) or just raw inference cost?

Aisha: End-to-end preferred so customers see real unit economics. Call out assumptions in small footer. Keep axes consistent across panels.

Carlos: I’ll take the charts. Quick ask: give me a tiny CSV with model variants + median + p95 + $/1k. I’ll make a sparkplot + three small panels.

Evan: Got a rough export, pasted below — these are synthetic/rounded but close to our tested slices. Feel free to tweak before plotting.

Evan: ```
model,mode,median_ms,p95_ms,dollars_per_1k
redwood-rtx-hosted,hosted,22,120,0.18
redwood-rtx-dedicated,dedicated,18,95,0.14
redwood-rtx-private,private,26,140,0.12
open-llama-hosted,hosted,40,240,0.10
open-llama-dedicated,dedicated,36,200,0.08
open-llama-private,private,44,260,0.07
```

Carlos: Perfect. I’ll iterate two viz directions: (A) minimalist sparkplot with color by mode, labels for median and p95 callouts; (B) story-first three panel with the token-econ chart emphasizing $/1k buckets.

Dana: I’ll do slide copy + two thumbnail layouts for the social clip. Two tonal variants: (1) "developer-first" — focus on predictability and dev velocity; (2) "enterprise-SLA" — focus on predictability + cost governance. Which one should we prioritize?

Aisha: Prioritize developer-first for the website/social funnel, but make an enterprise-ready variant for sales follow-up. Keep copy short: 1-line hook + 2 bullets. Example hook: "Predictable latency. Lower token cost. Same API."

Ben: For inbound routing, recommend tagging leads from the benchmark page: utm=bench_dev (developer-first) and utm=bench_enterprise (enterprise). Can we add a small CTA toggle on the landing slide so we can A/B route signups to separate nurture flows?

Carlos: I can export PNG + CSV for analytics. ETA for first drafts: 5pm PT today.

Dana: I’ll drop two PNG thumbnails for the social clip and the slide copy by 3pm PT.

Evan: One note — for token-econ, we should include a short example calc in the footer: "Assumes 1k prompts @ 1k tokens total. Pricing + egress applied." keeps it concrete.

Aisha: Love it. Quick checklist: Carlos (charts) → 5pm, Dana (copy + thumbnails) → 3pm, Evan (assumptions + CSV) → done, Ben (routing) → config after assets live. If anyone hits a blocker ping me and I’ll re-prioritize. :thumbsup:

Ben: Will handle routing + tracking. I’ll post the tag config in #growth once PNGs are up.

Carlos: Uploading drafts in ~3h. Will include raw plot code snippet and a small note so design can match colors.

Dana: Copy drafts incoming — keeping CTAs: "Try our hosted API" and "Talk to sales about Dedicated" for the two variants.

Aisha: Awesome team — thank you. If the sparkplot looks tight we’ll use it as hero visual on the benchmark page and in the webinar promo.

Carlos: :rocket:
